messages:
jordan: Heads-up — onboarding customer hit a weird DX/telemetry issue in the Node sample-app. After toggling OTEL exporter on, request IDs vanish from our logs and the hot log-level toggle (POST /debug/loglevel) does nothing. Repro steps and snippets below, need a quick patch or rollback plan. cc @maya @liam

maya: Which sample-app version? any custom middleware order?

liam: Seen something similar — the OTEL init hooks rewrap console and our redaction middleware runs before req-id injection so req_id gets lost. Pretty subtle ordering bug.

jordan: Repro env we used:

```
export REDWOOD_SDK_VERSION=0.12.2
export REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otlp.staging:4317
node apps/sample-app/index.js
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST" http://localhost:3000/api/generate
```

Observed logs (note missing req_id):

```
2026-03-09T15:02:31.123Z INFO  http: incoming request path=/api/generate method=POST req_id=null user_id=demo
2026-03-09T15:02:31.125Z DEBUG sdk: starting-call model=gpt-3.5 input_tokens=34
```

maya: Oof. Does turning off OTEL restore req_id?

liam: Yes, toggling OTEL env off returns normal logs with req_id populated. Looks like otel hook wraps our logger and strips custom context. Also the /debug endpoint is implemented by changing process.env at runtime but console/logging layer caches level at init, so SIGHUP not wired.

jordan: Quick mitigation ideas?

liam: Short-term: revert the OTEL auto-hook in the sample-app Dockerfile so onboarding customers on staging get old behavior. Medium: fix hook order in SDK so req-id middleware runs before any global console/telemetry wrapping. Patch sketch: add explicit init ordering and expose a `redwood.telemetry.init({deferConsoleWrap: true})`.

maya: Can you paste the minimal middleware order we want?

liam: Sure — current (bad) order in app.js:

```
app.use(otelHook())
app.use(redaction())
app.use(reqId())
```

Desired (fix):

```
app.use(reqId())
app.use(redaction())
app.use(otelHook())
```

jordan: That explains missing req_id — redaction/otel runs before reqId so log context empty. Also: hot log-level toggle should mutate an exported logger instance, not env var, so add `logger.setLevel()` endpoint.

telemetry-bot: Note: release 0.12.3-rc includes telemetry init changes PR#4217 (status: in review).

maya: If we rollback sample-app image, which tag do we use? devex-bot can we deploy previous image? @devex-bot

devex-bot: Deployment scheduled: sample-app:0.12.1 -> staging at 2026-03-09T16:00:00Z. Will post when complete.

liam: Action items:
- revert image on staging (jordan)
- add test that ensures req_id present when otel enabled (maya)
- expose logger.setLevel and wire /debug/loglevel to it (liam)
- make telemetry init opt-in or deferred wrap (sdk team / PR 4217)

jordan: I'll open a short-lived incident and link the rollback. Assigning to @maya for unit test and @liam for logger patch. Thanks. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll add e2e that runs with OTEL_EXPORTER set to ensure req_id in logs. Quick unit should fail on CI in about 20m.

devex-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-134 (telemetry: sample-app onboarding logs missing req_id). Linked PR: none yet.

jordan: Update: rollback applied and staging logs show req_id again. Leaving this open until SDK patch merged and tests green.

liam: I'll draft the sdk patch today. Will include a config flag and a small migration note for sample apps.

maya: +1. reopening if anything else pops.
